During the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] preparations to [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|attack]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TotJ" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="date">The [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] is dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> he gathered [[Sith invasion fleet|his military forces]] from all across the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], including from a '''planet''' on whose surface a large, light-gray-[[Color/Legends|colored]] building had been built. In that year, it [[Water/Legends|rained]] in the vicinity of the building, and Sadow's [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] caste loaded pieces of military technology&mdash;pulled over the muddy ground by quadrupedal beasts of burden&mdash;onto waiting Sith [[Starship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="TotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
To date, the planet has only appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|second]] issue of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''The Fall of the Sith Empire'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published in [[1997]] and was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]]<ref name="TotJ" />
